name: The Lunar Festival
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: It's that time of the year, adventurer!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival.  You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight.  She can tell you more about the holiday.
narrative.objectives: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
narrative.offerRewardText: Welcome, adventurer. Are you here to join in the festivities?

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 60, 650 XP in all.

quests.name: The Lunar Festival
quests.objectiveText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.

quests.name: Lunar Fireworks
quests.objectiveText: Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.

quests.name: Valadar Starsong
quests.objectiveText: Use your Lunar Festival Invitation in the moonlight to travel to Moonglade.
